en:night.text: Everyone, close your eyes. Our one night begins.

en:ready.text: Check your secret role and read its instructions. Press ready when you understand.

en:discussion.text: Everyone, open your eyes. Discuss what happened during the night. Your card may have changed. Do not look at your card again.

en:voting.text: Time to vote. Choose another player. Everyone must vote before the results are revealed.

en:results.text: The votes are in. Reveal the final cards and check who won.

en:role-markReview.text: Everyone, secretly check your mark, then close your eyes.

en:role-lovers.text: Players with the mark of love, open your eyes and find each other.

zh:night.text: 天黑了，请所有玩家闭眼。一夜狼人杀，现在开始。

zh:ready.text: 请查看自己的身份和技能。阅读完毕后，请点击准备。

zh:discussion.text: 天亮了，请所有玩家睁眼。现在开始讨论。你的身份可能已经改变，请不要再次查看底牌。

zh:voting.text: 现在开始投票。请选择另一位玩家。所有人投票后，将揭晓结果。

zh:results.text: 投票结束。现在揭晓最终身份和胜负结果。

zh:role-markReview.text: 请所有玩家秘密查看自己的印记，然后闭眼。

zh:role-lovers.text: 拥有爱情印记的玩家，请睁眼，互相确认。
